text: 8月以来，黄金类ETF持续获得资金流入，截至9月14日，境内黄金相关ETF资金净流入超过百亿元。与此同时，8月全球实物黄金ETF资金净流入约180亿美元。近期，油价上涨及美联储加息预期升温令金价短期承压。但从中长期来看，多家机构认为，央行购金、储备多元化和避险需求仍为黄金提供支撑。(上证报)
text_en: Since August, gold ETFs have continued to attract capital inflows. As of September 14, net inflows into domestic gold-related ETFs exceeded 10 billion yuan. Meanwhile, global physical gold ETFs saw net inflows of about $18 billion in August. Recently, rising oil prices and heightened expectations of a Fed rate hike have put short-term pressure on gold prices. However, over the medium to long term, multiple institutions believe that central bank gold purchases, reserve diversification and safe-haven demand will continue to support gold. (Shanghai Securities News)
